purpose: Run the already frozen M7B kernels against the original verified 41-event, 472-decision M15 observation set, produce complete event misses and no-event false positives, and decide whether M7C prospective shadow reproduction may begin. Do not discover or retune rules during this run.

local_inputs.mt5_files_root: Read from MT5_FILES_ROOT in the existing local Mochipoyo .env.

run_method.instruction: Pull feature/mochipoyo-alert-research, open scripts/mochipoyo_alert_research, and double-click run_build_frozen_trigger_kernel_validation_once.bat. This follows the same location and local .env / SQLite one-shot launcher pattern as M7A and the earlier Mochipoyo stages.
run_method.window_behavior: The BAT keeps the window open on both success and failure so the result or error can be reviewed.

required_result_review: Confirm each genuine event is marked TRUE_POSITIVE or FALSE_NEGATIVE for every eligible frozen kernel.
Review all verified-window no-event false positives, not only summary counts.
Review 15-minute and 30-minute false-positive clusters by ticker and kernel.
Review BTCUSD and XAUUSD unchanged-formula results and both cross-symbol directions.
Review raw alert 5, the BTCUSD PRIMARY_LONG with RCI9 turn-up and MIXED EMA alignment.
Review raw alert 35, the XAUUSD PRIMARY_LONG with bullish EMA stack but no RCI9 turn-up.
Confirm derived strict EMA ordering matches stored ema_alignment on every eligible IDLE decision.
Treat EMA tolerance and EXIT threshold tables as sensitivity diagnostics only; do not select a replacement formula from them.
Use the generated M7C PASS/BLOCKED result only to authorize or block prospective shadow reproduction.

new_webhook_event_policy.m7b_formula_policy: Do not modify the frozen manifest, kernel formulas, thresholds, tolerance values, or PASS criteria after inspecting new events.
new_webhook_event_policy.m7b_data_policy: The official M7B runner enforces the original frozen event IDs and windows. Later events are excluded from M7B and reserved for M7C. A delayed/new event inside the frozen window fails closed.

after_local_execution.when_m7c_decision_is_pass: Create M7C prospective shadow reproduction using the unchanged frozen manifest. Do not historical-scan or enable delivery/execution.
after_local_execution.when_m7c_decision_is_blocked: Document the explicit blocking reasons. Do not rescue, retune, or select a different same-window threshold without a separately approved audit design.

prohibited_actions: Do not use M6A/M6B/M6C returns, MFE, MAE, win/loss, source EXIT profit, PF, or future outcomes to choose trigger conditions.
Do not use the alert bar high, low, or close.
Do not treat pre-collector history as verified no-event data.
Do not call independent proxy matches genuine historical Mochipoyo alerts.
Do not scan the full historical CSV.
Do not extract M5, H1, or other timeframes.
Do not claim the proprietary internal formula has been reconstructed.
Do not enable entry gate, Discord, MT5 orders, live-ready, or final signal.
